newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank sees room for fall in long Swedish rates.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank sees room for fall in long Swedish rates.

text.p: The governor of Sweden's central bank, Urban Backstrom, said on Thursday he saw room for a fall in Swedish long market interest rates.

"You cannot rule out scope for a downturn since long rates are still above what I would call a good European level," Backstrom told a news conference, but declined to specify how far he believed rates might fall.
Earlier the Riksbank announced a 50 basis point cut in its interest rate corridor, bringing deposit and lending rates down to 4.25 percent and 5.75 percent respectively.
It also announced a 25 basis point cut in its key repo rate, saying the new level of 4.60 percent would apply at each of the coming four reverse repurchase tenders starting next Tuesday.
